patch.value: Render declared contract changes with migration guidance
Render explicit SDK and CLI contract metadata once with before, after and migration guidance; expose structured JSON and audit missing migration text.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Main fc7e396 still classifies only type, title and resolution signals; no contract migration projection exists. Implement a shared metadata.contract_change projection for Markdown, JSON and audit, retaining unchanged output for undeclared items. Add real SDK non-git tracker regressions before implementation; PR 324 is excluded.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Baseline reproduction at fc7e396: both focused tests fail behaviorally. SDK-created declarations render under Fixed and Security with no migration line; audit reports Fixed and no migration gap. The producer uses a native object schema field and the SDK contractChange option because project fields reject --field (expected declared-flag policy). Shared projection now covers Markdown, JSON, grouping, breaking deduplication and milestone capture.

value.text: Revert proof: node scripts/prove-contract-changes-revert.ts passed 9 isolated fixed-pass / behavioral-revert-fail / restored-pass cases. PRRT_kwDOSfkApc60txTs: removing only the contract_change registration from activate (and rebuilding copied dist) makes the real runUpdate test fail with extension_item_field_unknown. Ready for orchestrator verification after the code, generated dist and append-only pm evidence are pushed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed review round after clean status and existing receipts check. Fresh remote main was one commit ahead; merge it before fixes. Two unresolved findings are valid: PRRT_kwDOSfkApc60w0W6 (null direct contract metadata shadows valid nested metadata) and PRRT_kwDOSfkApc60vzXu (contract summary title bypasses single-line normalization). General rules: nullish compatibility projections must fall back without discarding auditable standalone malformed values; line-oriented output normalizes every projected title through the same presentation policy. Search the whole package and exercise SDK, CLI, JSON/TOON, snapshots and packed Node/Bun consumers in synthetic non-git fixtures. Preserve previous regression tests and prove only new behavioral reverts in disposable copies.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class search completed across src, scripts, tests and public CLI/SDK projections. readContractChange is the sole contract source-precedence reader; all consumers already share it. Fix nullish fallback while preserving standalone null and malformed non-null direct values, including undefined-direct/nested-null history. getStringField already validates before metadata fallback; additive breaking flags and audience declarations have distinct existing contracts and are unchanged. Route summary and JSON titles through resolveEntryTitle, keep neutral closure first and explicit declaration titles ahead of close_reason, and normalize the final summary line to bound caller-supplied heading/version/category/title/id. Baseline: all 3 new adversarial tests failed. Fixed: 13/13 contract tests passed, including 90 precedence pairs through JSON/TOON round trips, 100 seeded titles across 8 grouping/entry-source combinations, and real offline npm-packed Node/Bun SDK/CLI/host consumers using synthetic non-git trackers. Prior neutral-JSON assertions were strengthened rather than weakened.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof: node scripts/prove-contract-changes-revert.ts passed all 14 fixed-pass / behavioral-revert-fail / restored-pass cases in a disposable copy. Five new independent reverts cover PRRT_kwDOSfkApc60w0W6 (restore undefined-only precedence), PRRT_kwDOSfkApc60vzXu (restore raw summary titles), the matching raw JSON-title bypass, removal of shared declared-title/entry-source policy, and removal of final one-line formatting. Each reverted behavior fails its adversarial property test with ERR_ASSERTION and passes again after restoration. The previous nine revert cases remain passing after the shared title refactor and main merge; neutral JSON now also asserts absence of contract metadata. No existing test was deleted or weakened. Full release gates will be attempted serially with at most two workers and a combined local time budget, preserving all thresholds.
